C&C Group plc
('C&C' or 'the Group')
Capital Markets Day
C&C Group plc today hosts a Capital Markets Day for institutional investors and analysts in Glasgow.

The event will be led by CEO, Roger White, and members of the Group Executive Committee and will provide an update on the Group's strategy and medium-term targets. The presentations will focus on how the Group will grow volume in C&C Brands and grow margin in Matthew Clark Bibendum, underpinned by operational excellence, people and culture, and technology and data.
At today's event, the Group will also set out its medium-term targets, including:
·       FY30 operating profit target of €85 million; and,
·       More than €100 million of cumulative free cash flow (net of lease costs and exceptional costs) generation over FY28-FY30.
Management will also outline a refreshed capital allocation framework with the following priorities:
1.   Maintaining a strong balance sheet, targeting leverage of 1.0x to 1.5x net debt to EBITDA (pre-IFRS 16 basis);
2.   Organic investment to support long-term profitable growth;
3.   Paying a sustainable and progressive ordinary dividend; and
4.   Deploying surplus capital towards growth opportunities, acquisitions and/or shareholder returns, depending on the relative attractiveness of available opportunities.
The Group updated on trading in its recent announcement dated 11 September 2026. No new information concerning current trading will be disclosed.

The presentation materials used during the event will be made available later today within the Investor Relations section of the Group's website. Certain sections of the presentations will be recorded and made available on the website early next week.

About C&C Group plc
C&C Group plc is a leading, vertically integrated premium drinks company which manufactures, markets, and distributes branded beer, cider, wine, spirits, and soft drinks across the UK and Ireland.

·        C&C Group's portfolio of owned/exclusive brands include Bulmers, the leading Irish cider brand and Tennent's, the leading Scottish beer brand; as well as a range of fast-growing, premium and craft ciders and beers, such as Heverlee, Menabrea, Five Lamps, Innis & Gunn and Orchard Pig. C&C exports its Magners and Tennent's brands to over 40 countries worldwide.
·        C&C Group has owned brand and contract manufacturing/packing operations in Co.Tipperary, Ireland and Glasgow, Scotland.

·        C&C is the No.1 drinks distributor to the UK and Ireland hospitality sectors. Operating through the Matthew Clark Bibendum, Tennent's and Bulmers Ireland brands, the Group has a market leading range, scale and reach including an intimate understanding of the markets it serves. Together this provides a key route-to-market for major international beverage companies.
C&C Group plc is an Irish incorporated company headquartered in Dublin and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.
